notes.title: Sicaria Hotfix 1.0
notes.content:
What we fixed

 controller is now fully supported
 Serial killer and Skill issue achievements now functional
 fire VFX visuals updated
 lighting in the Docks level updated
 main character skinning updated
 controls scheme layout images updated


Known issues

 when using controller at the beginning of each level the player must use mouse for a second for controller to work properly

notes.title: Sicaria Full Release AVAILABLE NOW
notes.content:
Dear Sicaria players.

we are proud to announce that Sicaria has been officially RELEASED!

Sicaria is a third-person stealth game set in ​Antwerp during the Eighty Years' War.
You play as an engineer, a person capable of overcoming any challenge through your own cleverness. Because of the war you lost an arm, but you were able to build a mechanical one.

Sicaria is a FREE game developed by a team of 40~ third-year students at Breda University at Applied Sciences during the course of 30 weeks.

DISCLAIMER! There is a fatal crash during the first playthrough, when you play again after it, the crash does not happen anymore. We apologize for the inconvenience

What's changed from EARLY ACCESS?

 3 more levels
 gadgets (bottles, smoke bombs and tripping balls)
 cinematics
 more takedown variety
 new main character model
 ranged enemies
 enemy group behaviour
 more steam achievements
 and more!


Known issues

 inconsistency with gadgets amount
 voice lines at the end of the first level are played twice
 the player gets hard locked if they die after planting the bombs in Docks level
 onboarding prompts might not display correct images when using controller (without using the mouse/keyboard first)
 controller camera speed might be slow
 there is a fatal crash when you play the first time due to resetting achievements, it does not happen again when you play other times, sorry for the inconvenience :)


Thank you for joining the journey and for feedback you can join our Discord channel: https://discord.gg/sNEuDNz4

notes.title: Sicaria Early Access has been RELEASED
notes.content:
We are happy to announce EARLY ACCESS RELEASE of Sicaria.

Sicaria is a third-person stealth game set in ​Antwerp during the Eighty Years' War.
You play as an engineer, a person capable of overcoming any challenge through your own cleverness. Because of the war you lost an arm, but you were able to build a mechanical one.

Sicaria is a FREE game developed by a team of 40~ third-year students at Breda University at Applied Sciences during the course of 24 weeks.

DISCLAIMER! This game is released in EARLY ACCESS and does not represent the final experience. The full version is set to release in 2~ months so if you like the concept of the early access provided we will be happy to see you back for the release of final experience.

What is in the Early Access
In the Early Access you can play in a marketplace level using the game's core stealth mechanics like sneaking around, climbing and mainly taking down the enemies. This level has been through a second art pass representing the feel of the 80 years war Antwerps.

What is planned for full release

 Onboarding level introducing the player to core mechanics
 More stealth mechanics like whistling, body carrying and a secret mechanic to be announced.
 Improved optimization
 and more!

Known issues

 settings are not being saved when game is closed
 checkpoints are not being triggered
 enemy takedown highlighting is inconsistent
 enemies cannot attack you while climbing
 UI buttons do not change image when switching between keyboard and controller
 when re-pausing the game ambience and music stops playing
 Penta-kill achievement inconsistency
